title: AccountDirectoryDeletedPayload

accountId.description: An account's id on its environment: a version 4 UUID the environment mints when it adopts or adds the account; an account carried over from configuration keeps the id it was configured with.

directory.description: The owned directory deleted, with the sign-in and history it held.

description: account.directory-deleted: a removed owned account's directory was deleted, on the explicit second choice or a duplicate identity's refusal.
